Class GameStateHolder

java.lang.Object
services.game.GameStateHolder
public class GameStateHolder extends Object
Singleton holding the shared game session state. Used to pass model objects between controllers without coupling them directly.

      public void setCurrentLevelTower(LevelTower levelTower)
      Sets the current level tower for the game session.

      Stores the tower instance so it can be accessed across controllers during tower progression.

      Parameters:
      levelTower - the LevelTower instance to set

    • getCurrentLevelTower

      public LevelTower getCurrentLevelTower()
      Returns the current level tower.

    • advanceStep

      public void advanceStep()
      Advances the current level tower to the next step.

      Delegates to the LevelTower.advance() method to progress the player through the tower's floors and steps. Should be called after each tower node is completed.

      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if the current level tower is not set

    • clearCurrentLevelTower

      public void clearCurrentLevelTower()
      Clears the current level tower from the session state.

      Should be called when exiting the tower or returning to the title screen.
